feed.title: NPR Topics: National
feed.subtitle: NPR coverage of national news, U.S. politics, elections, business, arts, culture, health and science, and technology. Subscribe to the NPR Nation RSS feed.

entry.title: DOJ defends White House media ban, urges court to reject lawsuit
entry.summary: The Department of Justice defended President Trump's recent media ban, arguing that reporting by CNN, MS Now and Politico on a wide range of issues jeopardized national security and spread falsehoods.

entry.title: Major news outlets banned by Trump will have their day in court
entry.summary: CNN, MS NOW, and Politico are asking a federal judge to hold the president in check for what they say is a violation of their Constitutional rights simply because he doesn't like how they cover him.

entry.title: There's growing concern that Trump may deploy the National Guard ahead of elections
entry.summary: Fears are growing that President Trump may deploy the U.S. military to polling places in the upcoming elections, despite strict state and federal laws against such a move.

entry.title: ICE is looking into 'mobile detention facilities'
entry.summary: Buried in the paperwork for Immigration and Customs Enforcement's expansion in Pennsylvania is a document requesting "mobile detention facilities."

entry.title: Poll: Most voters agree the 2026 midterms are all about Trump — and they disapprove
entry.summary: A new NPR/PBS News/Marist poll finds President Trump — and his unpopularity — is an outsize factor in why most voters say they want Democrats to win the midterms.

entry.title: Morning news brief
entry.summary: Trump flaunts U.S. power during UNGA speech, poll finds Trump's unpopularity is a major factor swaying voters to Democrats for midterms, media outlets banned by Trump get their day in court.

entry.title: In Utah, trails are being adjusted to allow adaptive bikes better access
entry.summary: New technology, including electric motors, means disabled people can get out on mountain trails. But those trails need to be modified to make them friendly for hand-cycles or three-wheeled ebikes.

entry.title: Trump administration to remove 760,000 Affordable Care Act enrollees over fraud claims
entry.summary: White House officials allege these individuals were fraudulently enrolled in the program or do not exist. Vice President Vance said the move would save $2.2 billion.

entry.title: How abuse in some of Tennessee's juvenile prisons remained under wraps
entry.summary: Employees at a group of privately-run juvenile detention facilities across Tennessee failed to report suspected physical and sexual abuse to the state, and were allegedly discouraged from calling 911.

entry.title: Questions remain after grand jury declines indictment in Nolan Wells' death
entry.summary: The Black Mississippi teen's family questions whether his race contributed to his July 4th death on an island off the Mississippi coast.
